module: Flowgraph node "Rally Stage Countdown Setup" (category once_instant, tag rally, no pin). Prepares the rally countdown UI flow before the stage fade-in: loads the rally loop extension if needed, clears the rally manager's split times (clearSplitTimes), reads the countdown settings (StagedCountdownUtils.getStageCountdownSettings, defaults duration 3 and 3 announcements max) then fires the onRallyDataUpdated hook with the inactive state and countdownData {countdown = duration, state = 'waiting'}.

workOnce.desc: Executes the preparation described above only once.
